author: Lynn Pagans
text: Leave your insurance company out of getting your sensor replaced. This is between you and Abbott.  Go online and chat with an Abbott representative. They should be able to help you.

author: Stephanie Johnson
text: Aetna is absolutely awful insurance. They’re an option with my employer provided insurance. I called them to ask about insulin and I would have had to meet my $1800 deductible BEFORE they’d pay for insulin. Needless to say I chose another plan with another provider.
